title: Embeddings on Consumer GPUs: Local Search That Stays Resident
description: Which embedding models fit beside a chat quant on a 6GB card, real VRAM costs, and three local runners: Ollama, llama.cpp, Python.
lead: Embeddings are the always-on half of local AI: small, fast, and called constantly. This guide compares the three models that cover nearly every need, shows three ways to serve them on a consumer GPU, and explains how to keep one resident next to a chat model without blowing the VRAM budget.
